notablePrerequisites: Clearwater Goblet has at least five charge counters.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Clearwater Goblet triggers, causing you to gain at least five life.
At the beginning of your end step, Lathiel triggers, putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
